ppt: The system combines flow-level current-risk assessment, next observed-window forecasting experiments, packet-level attack-family characterization, transparent MITRE evidence, and explainability in an offline analyst view.
Stage-2 characterizes seven botnet attack families from packet-window behavior; it is not presented as a normal-vs-attack detector.
The analyst view preserves Stage-1 and Stage-2 provenance as separate evidence channels.
demo: Forecast trajectory is an observed-window state forecast; persistence is the strongest validated reference because labels are highly contiguous.
MITRE results are rule-based evidence, not a trained ATT&CK classifier.
Contextual evidence from independent dataset/capture pipelines; not a supervised temporal fusion prediction.
architecture: Real flow+packet temporal fusion is blocked pending co-captured data with defensible correspondence.
State-transition results are an experimental network-state proxy with weak chronological test generalization.
judge_explanation: Learned binary forecasting does not currently beat persistence.
No lead-time, real-time, unseen-attack, world-model, or cross-stage predictive-fusion claim is made.
